sources.summary: Published part (10 pages) of the DRIEAT Seine-Saint-Denis unit's report on the 15 October 2025 inspection of EQUINIX FRANCE SAS at 110 bis avenue du Général Leclerc, 93500 Pantin, AIOT 0007409817, regime Autorisation, IED yes. It states that a company was authorised by prefectoral order of 24 January 2011 to operate, on the communes of Bobigny and Pantin (access) on the site of a former postal sorting centre, a data centre named 'PA4'; that by a change-of-operator declaration of 1 August 2013 Equinix France SAS took over the operation of the site, operated since 2012; that a new building named 'PA8' (ground plus two storeys with basement) was built in 2018; and that the site has 22 generators dedicated to building PA4 and 12 dedicated to building PA8, with 2024 and 2025 running-hour records. It ties the IBX codes PA4 and PA8 to the register establishment and its point.
